question: Using the omicwas R package's ctcisQTL function, perform cell-type-specific cis-QTL analysis on methylation data with a 1 Mb cis window, controlling for the provided covariates.

expected_output.description: rows as SNP-CpG-celltype associations, columns should include term (SNP), response (CpG site), celltype, estimate, statistic, p.value
